title: Customers wear a design system only on Tracy Business / Joomla (403 DS_TEMPLATE_LOCKED elsewhere, staff pass); JA Kinetic WordPress palette reads its header as bg, not band
expect: S1: every test passes: a customer on a template other than joomla/tracy-business gets supported:false, TEMPLATE_NOT_READY, locked:true from the support and site reads and 403 DS_TEMPLATE_LOCKED from both preview doors (template-default excepted), the apply door and POST /api/sites {designSystem}; a site already wearing a system keeps its name and undo; an accepted tracy_admin seat and the /ops probe pass.
S2: every test passes: Add site shows no Design system card for a build that cannot wear one; the start screen row hides for a locked, unworn site.
S3: every test passes, and in the Kinetic palette #0a0d0c maps to bg and #fbfcfa is not a band.
evidence: Customers could pick, preview and apply design systems on templates that are not design system ready and saw the results as bugs; on JA Kinetic WordPress the header light-dark() ground was read as a band on a dark demo and hid the nav text in light mode
fence: joomla/tracy-business stays open to customers; staff are never locked; a worn system is never taken off
